ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, the center of the circle is O, A and B are on the circle, and AB is a chord above; point Y is on the minor arc from A to B. Segment OY starts from the center O and passes through point X on chord AB, and the right-angle mark in the figure indicates OY ⟂ AB. Reasoning: The problem gives that the measure of minor arc AB is 60°. According to the theorem, a radius or segment drawn from the center perpendicular to a chord bisects that chord and the minor arc it intercepts. Therefore Y is the midpoint of minor arc AB, so m⌒AY = 60° ÷ 2 = 30°.

raw_record.question_text: Circle $O$ has a radius of $10$, $AB=10$ and $m\overrightarrow{AB}=60$. Find $m\widehat{AY}$.

method.method_draft: Use the diagram to identify that segment OY passes through point X on chord AB and is perpendicular to chord AB, with Y lying on the minor arc from A to B. From the text, take the given measure of minor arc AB as 60 degrees. Apply the theorem that a radius or line from the center perpendicular to a chord bisects both the chord and the chord's intercepted minor arc. Therefore Y is the midpoint of arc AB, so arc AY is half of 60, which is 30.

method.method_draft: Use the diagram to see that A and B lie on circle O, so OA and OB are radii, and that OY is perpendicular to chord AB. From the text, the radius is 10 and AB = 10, so OA = OB = AB = 10. Thus triangle AOB is equilateral, making central angle AOB equal to 60 degrees. Since OY is perpendicular to base AB in this isosceles/equilateral triangle, it also bisects angle AOB, so angle AOY is 30 degrees. The measure of arc AY equals central angle AOY, so m arc AY = 30.

推理：圆 O 的半径是 10，所以 OA=OB=10。题目给出 AB=10，因此 OA=OB=AB=10，三角形 AOB 是等边三角形，所以中心角 ∠AOB=60°。在等腰/等边三角形 AOB 中，从顶点 O 作到底边 AB 的垂线 OY 也平分 ∠AOB，因此 ∠AOY=60°÷2=30°。弧 AY 的度数等于对应的中心角 ∠AOY，所以 m弧AY=30°。
